name: vicaria
description: Vicaria for Codex: type vicaria connect once, and every session is recorded under the consent you gave on the website until vicaria off. vicaria feedback up or down, with a comment, marks a reply.

interface.shortDescription: Keep your Codex sessions and learn from them
interface.longDescription: Records each Codex session, with its reasoning summaries and token counts, to your Vicaria account under the consent you gave on the website. Type vicaria connect to connect this computer, vicaria status to check a session, and vicaria off to pause it.
